description: Generate (or regenerate) ONE image of a LinkedIn/X article: marker 0 is the cover, 1..N are the inline images at the [Image N] placeholders. 30 credits per call. Optional `prompt` gives creative direction; omit it to use the slot's stored prompt. Synchronous. Returns the updated image slot; call get_social_article for the full kit.

prompt.description: Optional creative direction for the new image.

name: generate_social_article_image
